title: Motorcyclist overhears Bigfoot 'talking'
excerpt: A motorcyclist claims to have overheard Bigfoot talking in a Californian forest.
content:
A motorcyclist claims to have overheard Bigfoot "talking" in a Californian forest.

Has Bigfoot been overheard 'talking'?

The witness - named only as Shane O - was riding to work in Devore, California back in May 2024 when he stopped for a coffee break on a "forest road" and heard "talking" coming from the woods but the language sounded like gibberish" and Shane was convinced he was hearing a conversation between two Sasquatches.

Reporting the sighting to the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO), Shane explained: "I was working in Devore, California and every morning I would get a coffee and a muffin and would ride my motorcycle up Palm Ave. off 215 freeway until it became a forest road.

"On May 21, 2024 at about 5:15 AM, I had parked my motorcycle and was standing next to it when I could hear some 'talking'.

"I thought my bluetooth headset had came back on as I still had my helmet on, but it wasn't. So I took my helmet off to listen to whoever was coming toward me.

"The talking I heard was from two distinct and different voices. That's when I noticed it wasn't any language I had ever heard. It was a gibberish that didn't produce any real words. The voices weren't exceptionally loud and were probably only about 20 to 30 yards from me."

After deciding the talking must be coming from Bigfoots, Shane decided to make some noise to scare the creatures away before hearing a call from a third animal in the distance.

He added: "I have grown up in and around Fontana [city in] San Bernardino ... I have been aware of all the Sasquatch sightings around the area.

"I proceeded to act like a gorilla and make ape like growls and at that point the gibberish ceased. I made very loud growls and jumped around throwing sticks and dirt in the air.

"After 30 or 40 seconds there was no sound so I quit what I was doing and proceeded to quietly drink my coffee and eat my muffin. After a couple of minutes I heard another Sasquatch about half a mile away 'call' to the two near me. "

Shane decided to leave some of his muffin as a "gift" and he kept returning to the site with more offerings in the following days, explaining: "I left part of my muffin on a rock near me as a gift to them ...

"I went there everyday before and after the incident. After about three days after the incident my gifts were no longer being taken ... they had moved on."
